decisions.statement: A fleet answered as holding nobody is the pages being wrong.
The account the picker would take next is marked in the answer.
A fleet's usage is read upstream before the fleet is answered.
An account that was not refreshed is named under the numbers.
An account that was not refreshed is answered from the usage already beside its page.
A run starts no rate-limit window.
A run writes no value the commit has.
